fidelity: F2a — Full Electrochemical Model with Thermal ODE (carbonate CO3^2- transport, CO2 Nernst, Arrhenius kinetics, solve_ivp thermal lump)
source: Uchida et al. (1983) Electrochim. Acta 28(10):1423; Lu & Selman (1984) J. Electrochem. Soc. 131(12):2827; Yuh & Selman (1991) J. Electrochem. Soc. 138(12):3649; Bischoff & Huppmann (2002) J. Power Sources 105:216; Larminie & Dicks (2003) Fuel Cell Systems Explained, Wiley

N_cells.note: Number of cells in stack (FuelCell Energy DFC-class)

A_cell.note: Active cell area (0.1 m2 large-format MCFC plate)

t_mc.note: Molten Li2CO3/K2CO3 electrolyte thickness in SiC matrix (0.6 mm)

A_mc.note: Arrhenius pre-factor for carbonate ionic conductivity (Uchida 1983, 62/38 Li/K eutectic); calibrated so sigma~2.6 S/cm at 923 K

E_act_mc.note: Activation energy for molten carbonate conductivity (Uchida 1983)

i0_anode_ref.note: Anode exchange current density at T_ref (H2 oxidation in carbonate)

i0_cathode_ref.note: Cathode exchange current density at T_ref (ORR in carbonate, rate-limiting)

E_tn.note: Thermoneutral voltage at ~650C (HHV of H2, CO2-cycle adjusted)

m_stack.note: Stack thermal mass (300-cell MCFC incl. matrix/manifolds)

hA_cool.note: Cathode-air cooling-flow heat transfer coefficient * area
